field: Positivity of coefficients in algebraic combinatorics, centred on the stretched Littlewood-Richardson polynomials $P_{\lambda\mu\nu}(t) = c^{t\lambda}_{t\mu,\,t\nu}$ (polynomial in $t$ by Rassart; conjectured by King, Tollu and Toumazet in 2004 to have nonnegative coefficients) and their Ehrhart-theoretic structure through hive polytopes, with neighbouring positivity questions for Kronecker and plethysm coefficients. The question explored: which precise open statement about these coefficients would a specialist most want resolved, given the known rank reductions, the local Ehrhart formulas and the computed evidence.
